Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that both are genera by equating the common name “Cypress” with the genus Cupressus. This misclassifies a common name as a genus and ignores that “cypress” refers to multiple genera within Cupressaceae. The error stems from oversimplifying taxonomy and failing to maintain the common name vs. scientific rank distinction.
